verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a managed cloud service with serverless indexes, which the community explicitly calls 'fully managed'. Provisioning is programmatic: there is a control-plane API with a create_index endpoint and published OpenAPI specs, indexes can be managed via SDK, API, terminal or the MCP server, and backups and index copies can be created via SDK or API. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party guide on creating and configuring indexes programmatically (cloud/region selection, sizing), and hands-on corroboration of the provisioning workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a fully managed cloud version of the database with programmatic provisioning
